## Joseki

White uses the thicker hanging connection to develop one line further on the top. (Vol. 1.) Even so, Black's four stones surround more territory than White's four stones on the upper side. If Black can do this in all four corners, White will certainly lose. (Yilun Yang—Fundamental Principles of Go, p. 13.)

The continuation of <A:G17> supports an invasion at <X:M17>.
